statement: Fix the arithmetic data A, the bounded physical range dmin ≤ d ≤ dmax, and the height and loss hypotheses of Lemmas 8.1 and 8.2. Put U = Zd and retain the notation T1 of those lemmas. Let B be any set of retained sixth-power-free element rows u with qu ≍ U, all in one bin (i, a) with a > 51/100. Put δ = 2a − 1, so 1/50 < δ ≤ 1. For every ϵ > 0, after reducing the preliminary losses in Proposition 8.3, for all sufficiently large Z, #B ≪A,ϵ UR(δ)+ϵ (1 + T1)AA , R(δ) = min  1, max  1 − δ 2 , 4 3 − δ  . (9.16) The finite order AA is uniform in the physical dyad, the bin, and all moving rows. It may be fixed before the positive exponent in T1 = Zτ is chosen. The estimate is valid for each fixed retained tuple of external parameters and for the original row restrictions. The implied constant may depend on the fixed comparison constants and finitely many of the shared profile seminorms. The rowwise profile choices are precisely those permitted by Proposition 8.3 and Lemma 4.5; no arbitrary row-dependent coefficients are allowed. The floor bin a = 51/100 is excluded from the witness assertion. For that bin the elementary bound #B ≪A U applies; it agrees with the numerical value R(1/50) = 1.
